parsed.note_claim: Persona 3 Reload's UI theme reflects the original design intent and symbolizes the Sea of Souls and seaside locations like Port Island.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In P3R, I imagined combining the beauty of the sea from Port Island and Yakushima in the game, with the protagonist's "Sea of Souls."
parsed.reason: The developer interview explicitly confirms the UI design was intended to combine the sea from Port Island with the Sea of Souls concept.
